budget_items.topic: PAYT trash bags: bid and fee increase
budget_items.what_was_recorded: One bid was received for PAYT bags, from the current vendor WasteZero, and a report on the FY 2022 bag fee increase was deferred to June 15; a senior percentage discount was asked about but not answered that evening.
budget_items.quote: i will have a report and recommendation to the select board at their next meeting on june 15th on the payt bag fee increase for fy 2022.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Motor Vehicle Excise tax bills were sent out in May in the stated amount.
budget_items.quote: motor vehicle excise tax bills in the amount of $364,000 went out in may.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Finance Director submits quarterly spending reports for CARES funding and is reconciling changing FEMA and CARES eligibility.
budget_items.quote: also, she submits quarterly spending reports for the cares funding, with the latest due on june 4th.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Departments were told final FY21 purchase orders and requisitions must be opened by June 10 and encumbrance requests submitted by July 15; no dollar figures were printed.
